cases.query: D’après le README de bytes, de quelles dépendances dépend la version minimale de Rust si j’active extra-platforms ou serde ?
cases.expectation: For extra-platforms the minimum is tied to portable-atomic. For serde the minimum is tied to serde.
cases.provenance: Previously evaluated Bytes and serde_json README transfer

facts.expected: For extra-platforms the minimum is tied to portable-atomic.

sufficientAlternatives.text: The MSRV when `extra-platforms` feature is enabled depends on the MSRV of `portable-atomic`.

facts.expected: For serde the minimum is tied to serde.

sufficientAlternatives.text: The MSRV when `serde` feature is enabled depends on the MSRV of `serde`.
